behaviorMatrix.behavior: Every deterministic evidence operation runs against its own read-only candidate snapshot and proves the snapshot did not change.
behaviorMatrix.input: two sequential evidence operations where the first attempts a candidate write
behaviorMatrix.preconditions: the exact scoped candidate can be materialized
behaviorMatrix.expected: the write is runtime-incomplete, tree attestation remains explicit, and the next operation observes a pristine candidate

behaviorMatrix.behavior: Only a provider declared by a behavior cell, with the reciprocal cell declaration, may satisfy that cell.
behaviorMatrix.input: one-way or forged provider-to-cell evidence
behaviorMatrix.preconditions: manifest and evidence records are runtime validated
behaviorMatrix.expected: one-way declarations fail validation and forged records remain coverage gaps

behaviorMatrix.behavior: Every operation receives unique HOME and TMPDIR state, and prior operation residue is removed before the next operation.
behaviorMatrix.input: one operation writes a runner-state sentinel and the next probes for it
behaviorMatrix.preconditions: operations execute sequentially
behaviorMatrix.expected: the second operation cannot observe the first operation's HOME or TMPDIR content

behaviorMatrix.behavior: A regression RED operation succeeds only on its declared exact non-zero exit code.
behaviorMatrix.input: expected RED exit 42 but process, dependency, or sandbox exits differently
behaviorMatrix.preconditions: a regression provider declares base RED and candidate GREEN
behaviorMatrix.expected: unexpected non-zero exits cannot become verified-pass evidence

behaviorMatrix.behavior: Only deterministic runtime findings may carry verified-failure classification.
behaviorMatrix.input: semantic output references a failed evidence record
behaviorMatrix.preconditions: deterministic evidence has already been evaluated
behaviorMatrix.expected: semantic output remains a semantic concern and cannot promote itself to verified failure

behaviorMatrix.behavior: Runtime-owned verified failures remain blocking through semantic normalization and Work Map readback.
behaviorMatrix.input: a typed candidate operation violates its declared exit contract
behaviorMatrix.preconditions: semantic review runs after deterministic evidence
behaviorMatrix.expected: the final artifact retains verified-failure and Work Map requests changes

behaviorMatrix.behavior: Incomplete high-risk evidence blocks the semantic host while complete evidence permits exactly one initial call.
behaviorMatrix.input: complete and incomplete high-risk behavior matrices
behaviorMatrix.preconditions: deterministic providers have finished
behaviorMatrix.expected: host eligibility is derived from typed completeness and an ineligible run makes zero host calls

behaviorMatrix.behavior: A deterministic-only blocker lineage can repair typed evidence before its first semantic host call without replacing lineage authority.
behaviorMatrix.input: an authoritative hostCallCount=0 artifact, a repaired candidate, and an optional monotonic contract strengthening
behaviorMatrix.preconditions: all unresolved findings came from deterministic evidence and the predecessor receipt is current and unclaimed
behaviorMatrix.expected: the runtime reruns only affected typed evidence, preserves predecessor provenance, keeps failed repair blockers open, and dispatches exactly one initial semantic host only after evidence becomes eligible

behaviorMatrix.behavior: Closure reruns affected behavior contracts and closes only original findings with fresh matching evidence.
behaviorMatrix.input: initial artifact, repaired candidate, and optionally changed behavior manifest
behaviorMatrix.preconditions: initial semantic review produced stable finding IDs
behaviorMatrix.expected: closure uses one separate host call and emits a typed review-closure artifact

behaviorMatrix.behavior: Separated repairs are represented as bounded multi-hunk delta without unchanged middle content.
behaviorMatrix.input: two repairs separated by a large unchanged patch region
behaviorMatrix.preconditions: original and repaired candidate patches are available
behaviorMatrix.expected: the closure prompt receives compact hunks and never the original full patch

behaviorMatrix.behavior: A closure result can cite only fresh rerun records whose authorized behavior cells intersect the original finding.
behaviorMatrix.input: a finding for cell A and a passing rerun record for cell B
behaviorMatrix.preconditions: closure validates stable original finding IDs
behaviorMatrix.expected: the unrelated record cannot close the finding

behaviorMatrix.behavior: Persisted evidence records and completeness are reconstructed from the manifest contract before closure reuse.
behaviorMatrix.input: an automated cell with a forged disposition pass or forged completeness projection
behaviorMatrix.preconditions: an initial review artifact is loaded
behaviorMatrix.expected: artifact validation rejects the forged record or projection before closure

behaviorMatrix.behavior: Closure accepts an initial artifact only when an unspent installed-runtime receipt matches its full payload and review scope, and Work Map readback proves the immediately following repair attempt.
behaviorMatrix.input: caller-edited findings, evidence, timestamps, host count, Work Map scope, or a receipt from a prior claim attempt
behaviorMatrix.preconditions: an initial artifact path is supplied for closure
behaviorMatrix.expected: missing, spent, stale, cross-scope, prior-attempt, or mismatched receipts fail before evidence execution or Work Map transition, and the validated receipt is atomically claimed at most once

behaviorMatrix.behavior: Evidence commands can read only their candidate, isolated runner state, executable runtime libraries, and declared project dependencies.
behaviorMatrix.input: an evidence command attempts to read a file outside all declared roots
behaviorMatrix.preconditions: the macOS Seatbelt runner is available
behaviorMatrix.expected: the outside read is denied while the declared evidence operation still runs deterministically

behaviorMatrix.behavior: The macOS process startup baseline cannot reopen network, system socket, or Mach service output channels for evidence commands.
behaviorMatrix.input: an evidence command attempts to connect to the local system log socket or look up a baseline Mach service
behaviorMatrix.preconditions: the common system process baseline is imported before Goldband-specific denies
behaviorMatrix.expected: the socket connection and global-name Mach lookup are denied, every imported common Mach allow clause has an exact deny contract including registration and XPC prefixes, and no candidate bytes leave through the live-probed channels

behaviorMatrix.behavior: A dynamically linked evidence runtime executes from a sealed per-review projection instead of reading its original host package tree.
behaviorMatrix.input: a Homebrew Node runtime with transitive non-system Mach-O dependencies and host OpenSSL configuration
behaviorMatrix.preconditions: every source image and dependency edge can be resolved and content-attested before execution
behaviorMatrix.expected: the runtime executes from rewritten and signed projected images, cannot read the original Homebrew images, cannot mutate the projection, and produces a stable execution identity

behaviorMatrix.behavior: An explicitly declared zero-dependency Python 3.14 uv operation executes from a lock-bound candidate environment after runtime preflight.
behaviorMatrix.input: the repository Python runtime fixture, its pyproject.toml and uv.lock, and the declared Python version gate
behaviorMatrix.preconditions: the operation opts into pythonRuntime, declares no dependencies, and denies network access
behaviorMatrix.expected: the review runtime materializes the frozen/offline candidate environment and returns fresh verified-pass only after Python 3.14 runtime preflight and the declared gate succeed

behaviorMatrix.behavior: Secret-like untracked content stays out of the semantic diff but remains digest-bound and executable in each isolated candidate snapshot.
behaviorMatrix.input: a bounded regular untracked test file that triggers prompt redaction
behaviorMatrix.preconditions: the review includes untracked files and a provider executes that file
behaviorMatrix.expected: the prompt artifact contains only a placeholder, the binding includes its path and content digest, and the provider executes the exact bytes

behaviorMatrix.behavior: Only an explicit sandbox launcher failure signature is classified runtime-incomplete.
behaviorMatrix.input: a successful command whose ordinary output contains the word sandbox
behaviorMatrix.preconditions: the local Seatbelt runner launched successfully
behaviorMatrix.expected: ordinary program output cannot impersonate a sandbox launcher failure

behaviorMatrix.behavior: Closure provider selection resolves Git C-quoted paths and unquoted paths containing spaces across text, binary, mode-only, rename, and copy sections.
behaviorMatrix.input: text, headerless binary, and rename repair diffs for tab, newline, backslash, quote, and space-bearing filenames
behaviorMatrix.preconditions: the repair changes a provider-scoped path
behaviorMatrix.expected: the exact decoded metadata path selects the affected behavior cell for rerun and patch-looking hunk content cannot override it

behaviorMatrix.behavior: A deterministic early review failure remains bound to its Work Map subject and records the required state transition.
behaviorMatrix.input: implemented Work Map ticket with host-ineligible evidence
behaviorMatrix.preconditions: ticket receipt and candidate binding are current
behaviorMatrix.expected: a bound review artifact is written and the ticket transitions to requested changes with zero host calls

behaviorMatrix.behavior: Review artifact cleanup reconciles the authoritative Work Map after a transition error before deleting any artifact or receipt.
behaviorMatrix.input: a Work Map transition commits durably and then reports an I/O-style error
behaviorMatrix.preconditions: the review artifact reference is part of the pending or committed transaction
behaviorMatrix.expected: runtime recovery/readback recognizes the committed reference and preserves every referenced artifact; only proven uncommitted attempts are removed

behaviorMatrix.behavior: Evidence, phase, classification, and closure contracts remain type-safe.
behaviorMatrix.input: Goldband Loop TypeScript sources
behaviorMatrix.preconditions: dependencies are installed
behaviorMatrix.expected: the no-emit TypeScript gate succeeds

behaviorMatrix.behavior: The installer materializes the evidence-first review runtime and the trusted Codex launcher executes that installed copy.
behaviorMatrix.input: clean temporary Codex HOME and trusted launcher marker
behaviorMatrix.preconditions: source build and installer assets are available
behaviorMatrix.expected: installed-runtime tests observe evidence planning, phase, and closure arguments through the real launcher boundary

behaviorMatrix.behavior: Generated Claude and Codex workflow surfaces match the manifest owner.
behaviorMatrix.input: manifest, adapters, installer, and generated workflow contracts
behaviorMatrix.preconditions: surface generator inputs are present
behaviorMatrix.expected: the generated-surface drift check exits successfully

behaviorMatrix.behavior: Networked live, device, and production evidence executes only through an operation-specific authorized external runner.
behaviorMatrix.input: review evidence manifest or runtime enforcement change
behaviorMatrix.preconditions: the review-evidence provider applies to the candidate
behaviorMatrix.expected: deterministic tests prove that authorized network operations fail closed in the local runner
behaviorMatrix.reason: Issue #22 completed local fail-closed admission; external runner availability remains an operation-specific roadmap concern, not a global candidate gap.
